body:
I went to my local smoke shop about a month ago and bought the most potent extract of salvia. When I got home I was eager to try it. So I called my buddy over cause I thought I needed a sitter so I don't do anything stupid. Anyways he gets to my house and I pack a medium size bowl into my 2 foot bong and took it all in 1 hit. I waited about 5 min to see if i would get any effect and I didn't so I pack a second much larger bowl and hit it about 3 times before the bowl was done. I felt nothing but a little light headed, so I ended up packing 4 bowls in total and feeling no effect besides a weed like high for about 10 min and then it went away. I felt completely ripped off because I spent 40 us dollars on 1 gram and got nothing out of it. It was a bad experince and I recommend not paying that much for a gram.
